title: Engine package contract document
description: Structure binding for the EGM package contract documents under .vanguard/docs/engine/. One document per Go package; every claim must cite the exact file and symbol it describes. Declared by frontmatter: schema: package-contract.

anyOf.comment: Structural encoding of the markdown contract: the required H1 title, the four contract sections in order, and per-claim citation format. The x-vanguard block is the machine-enforceable projection consumed by the engine's structure layer; the prose keys remain the reviewed contract.

citation_format.const: [file.go:Symbol] — every interface, invariant, and side-effect claim cites the exact source location; no claims from names alone.

frontmatter_binding.const: id equals the file name, watches.paths covers the package's Go files, review_after present, schema: package-contract.
